subject: italian
summary: Question text is generally clean and the listening multiple-choice cards and the writing-task cards look deliberate. The main fault is the marking scheme on short-answer cards: one scheme sentence is chopped into separately tickable fragments ('for at least' / 'two' / 'weeks'; 'Non vogliono'; 'ad adottare/ ad avere una campagna/ un programma'), so the student never sees a readable model answer and the per-fragment marks make little sense. Two reading-comprehension cards (9 and 12) carry no passage at all, so the question cannot be answered from the card. Writing rubrics are long but readable; they have duplicated band headings ('0 – 5 · 0–5 marks'), broken sentences and refer to an 'Appendix 2' that is not shown. On the phone every card has a large blank gap between the question and 'Your answer', and in the capture most listening recordings showed 'could not be loaded'.

issues.title: Scheme sentence shredded into tick-box fragments
issues.detail: A single model answer is split into separate 1-2 mark checkboxes that are not meaningful on their own: card 11 'His family' / 'for at least' / 'two' / 'weeks' (1m each); card 12 'in tutti i quartieri' / 'soprattutto nelle periferie/ nelle zone'; card 10 one sentence in three 2m pieces; card 9 has a point that is just 'Non vogliono' and points ending in stray commas. The student cannot read the expected answer as a sentence and the alternatives are joined with slashes.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the full model answer as one readable sentence first (e.g. 'His family, for at least two weeks'), then list the mark breakdown underneath as labelled elements ('who: his family 1m; duration: at least two weeks 3m'). Put accepted alternatives on their own 'also accepted' line rather than slash-joined.

issues.title: Reading questions with no passage attached
issues.detail: Card 12 (2018 HL Section A Q1(b), journalistic comprehension) and card 9 (2018 HL B2A Q3(a), prescribed-text comprehension) show only the question and an 'Open original paper' link. Without the passage the question is unanswerable from the card; other reading cards (5, 10) do attach the passage.
issues.suggested_fix: Attach the passage page(s) with the same 'Read Section A' button used on card 10, ideally opening at the relevant paragraph.

issues.title: Scheme notes misplaced or muddled on listening cards
issues.detail: Card 1: the heading 'Travel / Trip / Food / Accommodation (2)' is followed by a note listing bookshop gift-card answers that belong to the other point; marks appear twice ('(2)' in the text and a '2m' chip). Card 4: the note under the options is a run-on of raw examiner shorthand ('(any two elements) (If just one emotion is given... Reasons - It's the first time /Living together (is not easy)/(Facing) other people's habits/ Language barriers)'). Card 2: the scheme says only '3. (c)' and never states the answer '52 km long'.
issues.suggested_fix: Attach each partial-credit note to the point it belongs to, drop bracketed marks that duplicate the chip, rewrite shorthand as short bullet lines, and for multiple choice show the correct option text and highlight it in the option list.

issues.title: Writing rubric: duplicated headings, broken lines, missing appendix
issues.detail: Band headings repeat the range ('0 – 5 · 0–5 marks', '6 - 7 · 6–7 marks'). Sentences are broken mid-line into separate paragraphs ('It is not' / 'necessary to use all the words', 'required for full' / 'marks'). 'Use the descriptors in Appendix 2' appears twice but the descriptors are not shown. On card 8 'Format 10 marks' has no criteria while the format criteria (greeting, date, address) sit under Content and communication. 'Lower scale applies · your content marks add to 0' shows before the student has chosen anything.
issues.suggested_fix: One heading per band ('0-5 marks'), rejoin the broken sentences, show the language descriptors inline or as an expandable block, move the format bullets under Format, and only show the lower-scale notice once a content mark has been chosen.

issues.title: Exam boilerplate left in the question text
issues.detail: Card 3 shows '(25 marks)' as its own line under the title although the card already has a 25m badge; card 8 shows 'Choose either (a) or (b). (50 marks)' then a lone '(b)'; card 9 shows three empty bullets (the paper's answer lines) under the question.
issues.suggested_fix: Strip mark tallies, answer-line bullets and the either/or instruction; label the card 'Option (b)' instead.

issues.title: Phone: large empty gap and very long rubric scroll
issues.detail: Every phone card has roughly 200-300px of blank space between the question (or attachment button) and 'Your answer'. The rubric cards run to about three phone screens-columns of scheme before the grade buttons. The attachment title is cut off on the phone ('Publicity piece 1 — answer in English or…').
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the minimum height on the question block on phones, collapse rubric bands behind a 'show band descriptors' toggle, and let the attachment title wrap to two lines.

issues.title: Listening audio did not load in the capture
issues.detail: Cards 1, 2, 6, 7 and 11 show '0:00 / 0:00 — The embedded recording could not be loaded. Open the SEC recording.' Card 4 (2026) loaded a 40:48 full recording with no cue to where Dialogue 1 starts. This may be a capture-environment problem but should be checked in the live app.
issues.suggested_fix: Verify the audio in production; where only the full recording exists, start playback at (or show the timestamp of) the relevant dialogue.

good_examples.why: Clear one-line question, scheme as seven clean 'any 4 of these' points that read as full statements.
Simple question, correct publicity piece attached, scheme is a tidy one-of list of jobs.
Multiple choice renders as proper option buttons and the scheme states the answer in words.
